title: somewhat of a silly question
content: I have been doing dream work for the last eleven years and I’ve had very intense, profound, and prophetic experiences throughout the years. I was drifting into a nap the other day and I started to step my foot through the veil or door of the dreamworld (like when you’re half dreaming, half awake). I would like to preface this by saying I do take the messages I get in dreams and especially this half dreaming state very seriously but that day made me chuckle. I started seeing and hearing a crowd of people, it seemed like they were in a conference room or something, and they were all trying to tell me something. They were talking over each other and just outrightly wanted to convey whatever message the dream intended, which I appreciate, but damn. After eleven years sometimes I miss the call haha! I was having crazy ptsd symptoms that day which is why I decided to even shut my eyes. In the moment I literally pulled myself up out of the dream and laughed to myself. Like I do not have the time today conference room entities! I will get back there when I can just give me a couple days lol. Idk if anyone has any other experiences similar or not. Also kinda non sequitur but does anyone remember those neuro sleep drinks? The one time I tried one I got the worst migraine of my life and when I went to bed I started having nightmares of shapes trying to talk to me too. It sounds funny now but was way more fever dream style in the moment haha! lol I lost track of my pulling throughout this post but I’d love to hear other people’s experiences with coming across messages that come off as annoying ? Any other fellow vet dream workers? appreciate you all here <3
